---
name: Harness support
about: Request support for a new agent harness
title: "[harness] "
labels: enhancement, harness
---

**Which agent CLI do you want support for?**
Name of the agent CLI (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode).

**Log format**
Where does the CLI write logs? What format are they in?

**Session storage**
Does the CLI have a session database? What format (SQLite, JSON, etc.)?

**Todo system**
Does the CLI have a todo/task tracking system?

**Additional context**
Any other details about the CLI that would help implement support.
